assets.name: hector
assets.processing: Original native PNG copied byte for byte; generated alpha preserved
assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: full-body character portrait for CosyWorld's painted Greek drama card game.
Input images: attached adult portraits are style references for painterly detail, natural anatomy, full-body scale, cloth texture and soft three-quarter staging. Create the new named subject with his own face and the specified clothes.
Style/medium: finely detailed painted storybook realism; earthy pigments, expressive adult face, natural skin, woven cloth, soft inner brushwork and readable silhouette.
Composition/framing: one living adult man is the sole subject. Tall 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas with genuine transparent background. Show the entire standing figure from crown of head through both complete feet and shoe soles. Keep clear margins on all four sides, especially under the feet. Use a gentle three-quarter standing pose, with uncovered head and face turned toward image-left. Keep every hand, limb and all clothing inside the canvas. The entire figure fills about 86 percent of canvas height.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral daylight on the figure, with gentle natural volume, suitable for compositing over both day and night paintings.
Output: native transparent alpha around the complete single figure. Only the man and his worn clothes or armor occupy the image. Both hands are empty. Every visible part of his body is whole and clean.
Subject: Hector, a distinct adult Trojan commander about thirty-seven. A strong, compact man with warm olive skin, a broad angular face, straight dark brows, attentive brown eyes, short wavy black hair and a close black beard. His bare head and thoughtful face read clearly. He wears a weathered plain bronze cuirass over a knee-length natural linen tunic, a dark olive wool cloak fastened at one shoulder, a simple leather belt and practical leather sandals. Natural bronze wear gives the armor texture. One hand rests lightly near his plain belt; the other opens low toward a person at image-left while he speaks. His bearing is responsible, alert and grounded, with calm adult authority. His individual face, dark hair and olive cloak distinguish him from the reference portraits.

Subject: Rhesus, a distinct adult Thracian commander about forty-two, shown as a living man in the arriving-allies frame. He is tall and lean, with a long oval face, pale olive skin, light brown eyes, medium-length chestnut hair brushed back and a short auburn beard. His bare head and clear face remain fully visible. A long-sleeved earth-toned woven undertunic sits beneath worn bronze chest armor, with a muted burgundy wool cloak and a plain leather belt. The tunic hem falls above the knees; leather greaves and practical dark leather footwear show both complete feet. One hand gathers the cloak near his chest, and the other opens in a small low speaking gesture toward image-left. His bearing is assured and curious. His long face, chestnut hair, auburn beard, taller build and burgundy cloak form a separate identity.

Subject: Rhesus's charioteer, a living adult traveller about forty-four. A lean, sturdy man with weathered olive skin, a rounder face, a broad nose, dark brown eyes, short tight dark curls and a short beard with grey at the chin. His expression is tired yet attentive. Ordinary travel clothes: a plain knee-length flax linen tunic, a muted slate-brown wool shoulder wrap, a simple cloth belt and worn leather sandals. A neat clean linen wrap rests around his right forearm, leaving his hand and fingers clear; the linen is whole and clean. His free hand opens slightly toward image-left as he gives his account. His posture is balanced and adult, with both feet planted. The cloth wrap is the simple visible care detail. The portrait shows a whole living man in ordinary clothes.

Subject: Polymestor, an older Thracian court host about sixty in the earlier public hearing frame. A substantial older man with a wide square olive face, a high forehead, deep-set clear dark eyes, carefully combed dark hair with grey at the temples and a broad trimmed salt-and-pepper beard. Both eyes, his face and bare head are fully visible and healthy. He wears a clean full-length cream woven tunic, a muted plum wool cloak with a narrow woven border, a simple fine leather belt with a small bronze clasp, and brown leather shoes. One hand holds the cloak edge at his waist; the other opens in a reserved low speaking gesture toward image-left. His expression is guarded and self-possessed, as a host answering a hearing. His mature face and court dress supply his identity in this earlier scene.
